{{nihongo|'''Okitsushima Shrine'''|奥津嶋神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

=== Shrine crest ===
Sasa-rindō

=== Origin ===
It is said to have been founded in {{ill|712|Q23521|qid=Q23521}} (Wadō 5) by {{ill|Fujiwara no Fuhito|Q177517|qid=Q177517}} under imperial command. It is regarded as the {{ill|Myōjin Taisha|Q9610964|qid=Q9610964}} listed in the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}''<ref>The standard view identifies this as {{ill|Ōshima & Okitsushima Shrine|Q11435100|qid=Q11435100}}.</ref>.
